results.title: African leaders call for greater local processing of minerals
results.content: African leaders on Monday called for stronger cooperation among countries on mineral policies and increased local processing of mineral resources to create jobs, develop industries and ensure the continent retains more value from its natural wealth.

results.title: Mahama urges African countries to focus on minerals processing locally
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has urged African countries to process their critical minerals locally and stop exporting raw materials.

results.title: Obuasi SHTS: ‘We have a broken system’ – Dwamena-Aboagye on support for survivors
results.content: Executive Director of the Ark Foundation, Dr Angela Dwamena-Aboagye, says Ghana’s response to survivors of sexual violence is broken, with support systems failing those who need protection.

results.title: Mahama urges Regent to preserve the peace of Dagbon
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama, on Monday, appealed to the Regent of Dagbon, Kampakuya Naa Yakubu II, to preserve the peace of the Dagbon traditional area.

results.title: Obuasi SHTS sex scandal: 38 teachers told to leave for criticising headmaster — NAGRAT President reveals
results.content: The President of the National Association of Graduate Teachers (NAGRAT), Jacob Anaba, has revealed that 38 teachers at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) were asked to leave the school after speaking against its headmaster, Zakaria Abdulai, amid allegations of sexual abuse involving female students.

results.title: Ghana seeks equity, not costly Eurobonds – Ricketts-Hagan
results.content: Ghana is prioritising equity investment over debt financing as part of efforts to sustain economic recovery and support long-term growth, Mr George Kweku Ricketts-Hagan, Member of Parliament for Cape Coast South, has said.

results.title: GH¢250m for NIA cards a misplaced priority, redirect into maternal healthcare – PAC to NHIA
results.content: The Public Accounts Committee (PAC) has expressed displeasure over the National Health Insurance Authority (NHIA)'s GH¢250 million allocation to the National Identification Authority for the procurement of identification cards.

results.title: NDC should ask embattled Obuasi SHTS headmaster to step aside – Dwamena-Aboagye
results.content: Executive Director of the Ark Foundation, Dr Angela Dwamena-Aboagye, says the NDC should ask the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School to step aside from his political role while sexual abuse allegations against him are investigated.

results.title: CAS ruling on Africa Cup of Nations final expected at end of November
results.content: A decision on Senegal's appeal after being stripped of this year's Africa Cup of Nations title will be made at the end of November, the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) said ​on Monday.

results.title: Morocco’s first female prime minister caught between the king, clerics, and feminists

results.title: CHASS backs interdiction of Obuasi SHTS Headmaster over alleged sexual abuse scandal

results.title: Oil eases as markets assess potential waiver on Russian energy, Middle East supply risks
results.content: Oil prices fell on Tuesday as markets weighed an executive order from US President Donald Trump that waived some sanctions and ‌tariffs on Russian energy exports, while attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen kept fears of Middle East supply disruptions in view.

results.title: Sexual abuse: Society’s laughter silences victims — Ark Foundation

results.title: Obuasi SHTS: NDC cites aspirant’s rights in decision to let him contest amid investigations – Gbande
results.content: The NDC says protecting the rights of its constituency chairmanship aspirant informed its decision to let him contest while investigations into sexual abuse allegations continue.

results.title: ‘We all know an abuser, but choose to protect them’ – Sexual abuse survivor

results.title: Obuasi SHTS: NDC could act against chairman aspirant before investigations conclude, says Gbande
results.content: The NDC could take action against a constituency chairman aspirant implicated in the Obuasi Senior High Technical School sexual abuse allegations before investigations conclude, Deputy General Secretary Mustapha Gbande has said.

results.title: Gold slips as investors weigh Fed rate outlook

results.title: Survivors feel a sense of guilt for failing to protect themselves from sexual abuse – Advocate

results.title: OpenAI seeks to accelerate fundraising ahead of Anthropic IPO, sources say

results.title: FIFA suspends coach Hassan and forward Zico for three and five matches

results.title: Billionaires fund Nigerian artists – Sarkodie

results.title: Mahama visits Kufuor to discuss national, global affairs
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has visited former President John Agyekum Kufuor at his residence to enquire about his well-being and exchange views on issues affecting Ghana and the international community.

results.title: Isaac Opoku raises Ghana’s flag high in London with Commonwealth honour
results.content: Ghanaian youth leader Isaac Opoku has been received by the Ghana High Commissioner to the United Kingdom and the Commonwealth Secretary General in London, as he celebrates being named one of the QECT 100 Young Leaders 2026. Isaac, founder of the Starlight Foundation, visited Her Excellency Mrs Sabah Zita Benson, Ghana’s High Commissioner to the United Kingdom, and Her Excellency Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey, Secretary-General of the Commonwealth, alongside two fellow Ghanaian awardees. During the visit, he shared his personal story, explained why he started the Foundation, and spoke about its work with children and families across Ghana. The three young leaders also presented the award plaques they had received. results.title: ‘An unacceptable breach’ – Hawa Koomson warns over alleged failure to act on Obuasi SHTS abuse complaints
results.content: NPP National Women’s Organiser has warned that school authorities’ alleged failure to act on sexual abuse complaints at Obuasi Senior High Technical School would amount to “an unacceptable breach” of their responsibility to protect students, if established.

results.title: Sinapi Aba golfers excel at 8th AGA Otumfour Invitational
results.content: Sinapi Aba Savings and Loans recorded two notable results at the 8th AGA Otumfour Invitational, with Lydia Opoku Ware winning the ladies’ competition and Tony Appiah finishing runner-up in the men’s event. The annual tournament was held at the Royal Golf Club, bringing together 72 golfers from clubs across Ghana to compete for honours and strengthen ties within the golfing community. The competition was played in the singles Stableford format, which awards points based on players’ scores on individual holes, with the highest total determining the winner.

results.title: Hawa Koomson demands independent probe into alleged abuse of 19 Obuasi SHS girls

results.title: Keeping Ghana connected when fibre cables fail
results.content: When a mobile-money payment fails or a hospital cannot reach a referral team, the customer does not ask which fibre route is down. The immediate question is whether there is another way to complete an essential task. That should also be the starting point for Ghana’s approach to telecommunications resilience.

results.title: Warning signs over threats to Australian politicians were rising before MP hit by car
results.content: As increasingly frequent acts of violence against politicians have shocked the globe in recent years, Australia has watched on with a contradictory feeling: that attacks like that could not happen here, and that it was only a matter of time until they did.

results.title: Spain’s rush to clear Ceuta migrant backlog raises rights concerns
results.content: When heavily pregnant Fatna and her disabled son arrived in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta during a chaotic mass border crossing on July 30, she hoped to be high on authorities' list for help.

results.title: Why is Obuasi SHTS headmaster still on NFA Board? – Juliet Asante asks
